body:
Added the cli verb viola adopt: a plain claude session, given by its session id, resumed under viola with an operator-given name, an optional parent and an optional model and effort pair.
Adopt starts like run and revive start: it logs as process run into the run log file of its name, through run's own process-start, process-exit and agents-probe lines and run's spans.
Its preflight order: home-tree strict-modes check, pinned exe check, run log open, name-holder collision check, then the session-live check over claude agents; a failed agents read still starts.
Its own refusals are two closed details, strict-modes-failed and session-live (exit 1, fixed unable and hint pair, or the --json document); run's shared details already-live, stale-heartbeat, pinned-hash-mismatch, squatted-name, socket-dir-refused and internal-error also reach it.
No new event, detail word, field, subject, span, env read, time bound or MCP tool; the diag-line schema is unchanged; the session id appears in no line, pair or detail.
The real-CLI check (R5) stays gated and unproven; the W1 to W4 widenings stand PROVISIONAL on the delegate's word.

body_fields.what: the viola adopt cli verb, new: a resume start of a plain claude session under a name and parent, its preflight order, its refusals strict-modes-failed and session-live, its lineage
viola revive: the session-id parser and the live-elsewhere (session-live) check, now shared with adopt, bodies unchanged
cli verb dispatch with its detail sink of process run, and the help's setup row of served verbs
the role taken from argv before clap and the silent roles at the internal-error catch site; adopt added as a named role
new test-only live-reading script for the real-CLI adopt check R5, with a rehearsal over the fake agent; never run by a gate
new adopt integration test binary: resume under name and parent, session-live refusals, strict-modes refusal before any log, the internal-error document, schema-checked run lines
plain cli output test: the help text literal and the served verb list
the cross-verb exit-cause table test: exit code, detail and hint per cause
the error-body census test over each writer of a refusal or error body
security negative env-capture tests, the verify_window class with its 80 s kill
integration test support: the test home and wrapper harness, now with an adopt start in an outer PTY

body: contract/strict-modes-refusal-exit/1: adopt's start joins the starts whose home or instance strict-modes refusal exits 1.
decision/home-tree-check-before-log-init and decision/home-tree-check-before-start-log: adopt's start runs the home-tree check before its run log opens.

Strict-modes refusal before a log opens writes no line (decision/strict-modes-refusal-writes-no-line, decision/pre-open-strict-modes-refusal-silent, decision/pre-log-strict-refusals-write-no-line, decision/refused-home-tree-writes-no-line, decision/strict-modes-failure-lines): adopt's refusal is one more such start.
decision/revive-start-logs-as-run: adopt's start likewise logs as process run; contract/cli-log-file/revive-start has an adopt counterpart.
contract/run-log-file/path and contract/diagnostics-files/run: adopt writes run-<name>.ndjson, role run.

session-live rows (contract/exit-1-detail/session-live, contract/run-exit-1-detail/session-live, contract/revive-preflight-detail/session-live): adopt now emits session-live, exit 1, with its own hint pair.
decision/revive-preflight-order: adopt's preflight is a second order of the same shape (strict-modes, pinned exe, log open, holder, session-live, launch).
decision/session-live-check-fails-open and contract/revive-process-log/agents-probe: adopt's session-live check fails open on a failed agents read and logs the agents-probe line.

Run start failure detail rows (contract/run-start-failure-detail/*, contract/process-exit/socket-dir-refused-on-start): already-live, stale-heartbeat, pinned-hash-mismatch, squatted-name, socket-dir-refused now also reach adopt's start.

decision/role-classified-before-clap and the internal-error catch rows (contract/cli-internal-error/json-document, contract/cli-internal-error/human-line): the word adopt is a named role, silent at the catch site; under --json an error before the child pumps prints the internal-error document.

claude agents output rows (decision/agents-cli-output-untrusted, decision/agents-probe-output-untrusted, decision/agents-cli-parse-failure-unknown, decision/claude-agents-rows-never-logged): adopt is a new reader of claude agents for its session-live check.

Run start events and child rows (contract/run-start-events/order, contract/claude-child-process-start/*, contract/run-process-log/process-start-claude-child): adopt's start launches the child with the resume argument and the typed-in id through run's start.
decision/detail-codes-no-paths and decision/typed-ids-never-in-detail: the operator-typed session id appears in no line, pair or detail of adopt.
Lineage rows (decision/lineage-line-untraced, decision/lineage-names-confined): adopt writes lineage parent from --parent else the inherited name.
contract/run-terminal-output/start-refusal and contract/cli-stderr/refusal-pair: adopt's refusals are one fixed unable and hint pair.

adopt's preflight order is home-tree strict-modes check, pinned exe check, run log open, name-holder collision check, then the session-live check, then the launch; the first refusal wins.
adopt refuses session-live, exit 1, when claude agents lists the id or a live adopted instance holds it; a failed agents read starts (fails open).

process-exit detail for exit 1 from viola adopt: strict-modes-failed, session-live, and run's shared already-live, stale-heartbeat, pinned-hash-mismatch, squatted-name, socket-dir-refused, internal-error.

The session added the CLI verb viola adopt: it resumes a plain claude session, given by its session id, under viola, with a name, an optional parent and an optional model and effort pair, given by the operator.
Adopt runs these checks in order: instance strict-modes, pinned exe, log open, holder collision check, live-elsewhere check. Then it starts the child through run's own start, with --resume and the id on the argv of a direct spawn, its own child in its own PTY.
A session that a live claude holds is refused as session-live, exit 1, with one fixed pair and no child started. A failed read of the claude agents list lets adopt start anyway. A malformed id is a usage exit 2 before anything is read.
Measured: the shared session-id parser accepts ASCII hex in either case, so an upper-case id parses. The plan's row saying an upper-case id is refused was wrong. Every security-plan row only says the closed session-id shape.
It adds no IPC method, event kind, log line, record field, env read, time bound, closed word, MCP tool, dependency or schema. Adopt logs as process run, through run's own lines. Nothing was retired.
W1 to W4 rest on the delegate's word and land PROVISIONAL. The real-CLI gate R5 is unfired, and matrix v2-13 stays claimed GATED.

The revive --id argument contract: adopt uses the same session-id parser. A malformed id is a usage exit 2 before anything is read.

The rows on reading the claude agents list (bounded, fail open, resolved from the caller's PATH) and the agents-probe log rows (content-free, redacted): adopt makes that read for its live-elsewhere check. A failed read lets it start (the W1 no-signal arm), and the probe line holds no id.

The revive refusal of a session a live claude holds, and contract revive-json session-live: adopt now carries the same refusal, with its own fixed pair and a session-live document under --json. It also refuses the id that a live adopted instance holds.

The named lists of starts checked for strict modes: the strict-modes refusal contract for run and revive, start checks the home tree before its log opens, home tree checked before any log opens, strict-modes check at start, a strict-modes refusal leaves no trace. Adopt's start joins each of them and is refused before any log, with the mode left as it was found.

The socket-directory refusal for run and the start of revive, and the rows that check the socket directory before any bind, snapshot or child: adopt's start goes through run's start and carries socket-dir-refused.
The start collision-check contracts already-live and stale-heartbeat, and the row that run's collision check is not server-verified: adopt runs the same holder check and prints run's collision pair.

The lineage rows: self-reported parent authenticates nothing, lineage kept to the snapshot and the event log, viola run's lineage flags checked before anything is read. Adopt takes --parent, otherwise the inherited VIOLA_NAME unless it equals the name. A --parent equal to --name is refused as a usage exit 2.

The launch-pair rows (flags checked before anything is read, refused after the dashes, handed on the claude child's argv, kept to the snapshot and the event log, authenticates nothing): adopt takes --model and --effort through run's own parsers and accepts no words after the dashes.
The recorded-cwd rows (cwd kept to the snapshot, spawn directory in the snapshot only, recorded cwd used only to spawn): adopt spawns in the current directory and writes that as the snapshot cwd.
The every-product-error-writer-named census and the fixed error display messages: three error bodies for adopt's writers were added to the census.

The catch-site internal-error output under --json, and the CLI internal-error document: an anyhow error in adopt before the pump prints the internal-error document, and adopt is silent at the catch site.

The pinned-binary rows (pinned viola re-hashed before use, pinned folder first on the child's PATH, run resolves its child program itself) and the pinned-hash-mismatch and squatted-name codes: adopt's start goes through the same checked exe and run's start.
The CLI input rows (CLI input trust boundary, CLI names through the viola name check, names through the validated name type): adopt's --name and --parent go through the name parser.
Refusals hold no paths, pids or ids, and no identity values in verification output: adopt's session-live pair and its documents hold no id, path or pid.
The rows that say unwrapped or claude agents names are not targets: adopt brings an unwrapped plain session under viola, under a name the operator gives. It never takes a name from the agents list.

Child spawn rows (direct spawn, parent identity variables and CLAUDE credentials stripped from the child): adopt's child is launched by run's own start, so the same rules apply to an adopted child. It acts on no other process.
The live-round rig rows (rig keys only into its own pty, live rig child isolated): the R5 adopt script is a new live-reading rig that ends only its own recorded wrapper and its own script host.
